name: clean-contract-errors-and-screenshot-revision
goal: Hide empty contract errors and label screenshots by their capture commit.

evidence: EntityContracts always render an empty Errors group; callable and service builders render empty Throws groups; summaries emit Fails with despite errors=[]; the screenshot pane labels scope.commit instead of its existing Evidence.source capture revision.

The standardized contract tests asserted empty-error copy or omitted only Inputs/Outputs; screenshot browser coverage asserted images but not figcaptions. Extend entity-preview-contract and entity-preview plus shared service contract tests to assert empty groups are absent and inherited captures are labelled with Evidence.source.
The committed Playwright regression failed on the old capture label; Harness stored the assertion output and screenshot at red commit 22a5b45eb.
The repair commit 6cb260fc9 omits undeclared Errors/Throws groups and uses captured screenshot provenance for captions.
The unchanged Playwright screenshot regression passed at 6cb260fc9 with the same command, fixtures and runtime profile as red checkpoint 22a5b45eb.
